# Genesis Apocryphon Column 22 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 22 | **Condition:** Well preserved; substantially legible

---

**22:1** And he set before her Hagar as a handmaid.

**22:2** And the king gave to me much silver and much gold and much clothing

**22:3** and fine linen and purple, and he set them before me,

**22:4** and Hagar also he gave to her as a handmaid.

**22:5** And I, Abram, went out with very great flocks and also with silver and gold.

**22:6** I went up from Egypt, I and all my household,

**22:7** and Lot went with me. And Lot also had gained much livestock

**22:8** and had taken for himself a wife from among the daughters of Egypt.

**22:9** And I encamped [...] at every place of my former encampments until I came to Bethel,

**22:10** the place where I had built the altar formerly.

**22:11** And I built it again and offered upon it burnt offerings and a grain offering

**22:12** to God Most High. And I called upon the name of the LORD there

**22:13** and praised God, and said: You, O God Most High, are my God forever and ever.

**22:14** And I went from there [...] southward [...] until I came to Hebron.

**22:15** Now Hebron had been built at that time. And I dwelt there two years.

**22:16** And there was a famine in all the land, and I heard that there was grain

**22:17** in Egypt. And I set out to go to the land of Egypt [...]

**22:18** And I came to the river Karmon, one of the branches of the River,

**22:19** [...] and I crossed [...] the seven branches of this river [...]

**22:20** And I passed through our land and crossed the breadth of [...]

**22:21** and I crossed the border of Egypt.

**22:22** And God said to me: Look from the place where you are,

**22:23** northward and southward and eastward and westward,

**22:24** for all the land which you see — to you I shall give it

**22:25** and to your seed forever.

**22:26** I have made your seed as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count

**22:27** the dust of the earth, then your seed also shall be counted.

**22:28** Arise, walk about in the land, along its length and its breadth,

**22:29** for to you I shall give it. And I, Abram, went traveling, going about

**22:30** to see the land. I began to travel from the river Gihon

**22:31** and came along the sea until I reached the mountain of Taurus.

**22:32** And I traveled from [...] the Great Salt Sea and went along the mountain of Taurus

**22:33** eastward through the breadth of the land until I came to the river Euphrates.

**22:34** And I traveled along the Euphrates until I reached the Red Sea in the east.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 22 is well preserved and completes the Egypt narrative before returning to the land-promise theme. The double mention of Hagar (22:1, 22:4) may reflect scribal repetition or emphasis. Lot's Egyptian wife (22:8) is an extra-biblical tradition. "The River" (22:18, capitalized) is the Nile. The divine land-promise (22:22-27) closely parallels Genesis 13:14-17. The geographical circuit (22:30-34) mirrors the survey in Column 19.*
